walk.method: Video-tail continuation of the approved 49-frame walk using extend --distilled
walk.note: Continued motion rather than a held frame or slowed two-second clip.

taxi_takeover.start: Closed door, player hand on exterior handle, driver seated inside
taxi_takeover.end: Driver seated on ground, player remains standing outside
taxi_takeover.control: Four-door opening reference and four-door grounded-driver endpoint; front seat positioning corrected, rear door stays closed.

drive: Approved first 97 frames of v4 drive, reused via v5; removed orientation reversal remains excluded.

stop_and_bailout.method: One multi-anchor generated shot, not two independently generated approach and jump clips
stop_and_bailout.camera: Same side as the retained recovery; taxi nose left, rear right; stationary lamp post and mall
stop_and_bailout.end_source: New four-door geometry; grounded player pose derived from approved recovery source frame 32
stop_and_bailout.caveat: Later image guides are soft constraints, not exact locked frames. The join to the existing get-up/run remains an editorial join and is visually checked.
stop_and_bailout.door_constraint: Front-hinged rigid door attached to A-pillar; one near-side mirror mounted on door. Reference repaired after user identified floating panel and duplicate mirror.
stop_and_bailout.selection_note: Full 121-frame four-door take selected after checking approach direction, open-door attachment, separate rear door and one mirror. No tail from rejected coupe-like takes is used.

recovery: Retained original v4 animation from frame 32 onward; prior windscreen ejection excluded. The assembled shot uses crop=432:768:0:160 to retain the original movement with a tighter camera following the player.
interiors: Hair-only reference edits establish short dark bob and gentle smile in welcome, mat and squat; motion regenerated locally. Reformer scene removed.
mat: 121 frames with starting and deeper down-left stretch guides, edited to 5 seconds.
ui: Separate PNG/SVG handbag HUD, Mobility popup on mat, Body Muscle popup on squat.
audio: Generated extension audio discarded. Original procedural effects only; no music or sampled game assets.
